verdict.rationale: Langfuse documents traces that capture every LLM and non-LLM step of a run, including tools, retrieval and API calls. It also documents sessions for grouping multi-turn conversations and graph visualization of agentic workflows, and community users confirm it is strong for tracing complex LLM pipelines. One user noted that retries clutter traces and asked for them to be collapsible, which affects quality but does not contradict the capability. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the nested span/observation hierarchy, explicit thread-level grouping beyond sessions, and better handling of retries in nested traces.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trace multi-step agent runs as nested spans grouped into sessions or threads
